analysis: The PR changes only docs/architecture/inference.md (head lines 2966-2970). It adds documentation that the control leader's cluster service re-plans and re-adopts a model after an update only once both Macs report the same worker build (ClusterOnboardingUpdate.oneBuild). It also adds a link to the pair's coordinated update in the cluster-always-on guide. The supplied units are base_text excerpts at lines 4495-5336. They were reviewed as surrounding context and contain no changed lines. This is a prose-only change with no code, configuration, key handling, or authorization logic. I checked it against the cluster-related and provider-loop threats (TB-011 and the T-052 to T-058 family, T-041 cache scope, and the A-016/A-017 qualification assets). It does not alter attestation, serving grants, qualification records, cache scoping, or encryption behavior. The wording describes a gating condition (same worker build) that narrows when re-planning happens, which is a conservative availability and consistency control. The documented claim relies on ClusterOnboardingUpdate.oneBuild and on the linked cluster-always-on.md anchor, neither of which was supplied, so I could not verify that they exist or behave as described. That is a documentation-accuracy question, not a security regression. No threat-model update is needed for this change.
